+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+
+import ast
+from io import BytesIO
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.errors import AnsibleError
+from ansible.executor import module_common as mc
+
+
+def test_package_relative_imports():
+    package = 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg'
+    finder = mc.ModuleDepFinder(package, is_package=True)
+    finder.visit(ast.parse('from .submod import X\nfrom ..cousin.submod import Y'))
+    assert (tuple((package + '.submod.X').split('.')) in finder.submodules)
+    assert tuple('ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.cousin.submod.Y'.split('.')) in finder.submodules
+
+
+def test_locator_candidates_only_for_nested_imports():
+    base = ('ansible_collections', 'ns', 'coll', 'plugins', 'module_utils')
+    assert mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(base + ('foo',), True).candidate_names_joined() == ['.'.join(base + ('foo',))]
+    assert len(mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(base + ('foo', 'symbol'), True).candidate_names_joined()) == 2
+
+
+def test_collection_redirect_precedes_local(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={
+        'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'old': {'redirect': 'other.tools.new'}}}})
+    local = mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', return_value=b'local = True')
+    parts = tuple('ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.old'.split('.'))
+    locator = mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(parts).resolve()
+    assert locator.redirected
+    assert locator.redirect_target == tuple('ansible_collections.other.tools.plugins.module_utils.new'.split('.'))
+    assert b'sys.modules' in locator.source
+    local.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_tombstone_has_collection_context(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={
+        'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {'old': {'tombstone': {
+            'warning_text': 'gone', 'removal_version': '2.0', 'removal_date': '2025-01-01'}}}}})
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='gone.*ns.coll.*2.0.*2025-01-01'):
+        mc.CollectionModuleUtilLocator(tuple('ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.old'.split('.'))).resolve()
+
+
+def test_finder_synthesizes_missing_collection_parents(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(mc, '_get_collection_metadata', return_value={})
+
+    def source(collection, resource):
+        if resource == 'plugins/module_utils/pkg/subpkg/item.py':
+            return b'VALUE = 1\n'
+        return None
+
+    mocker.patch.object(mc.pkgutil, 'get_data', side_effect=source)

+    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, 'w') as payload:

+        mc.recursive_finder('sample', 'ansible.modules.sample',
+                            b'import ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg.subpkg.item\n',
